title: Counting and membership
hints: Reading a key that's missing from a map returns the value type's zero value. So a stored 0 and a missing key look the same, unless you ask the map which one it is.
make(map[string]int) creates a writable, non-nil map. The two-value form v, ok := m[k] reports whether k is present.
WordCount: make the map, then do counts[w]++ for each word. Has: _, ok := m[key]; return ok.
